rejected_claims.reason: The driver says the rider did not object, but the only chat message is the driver's own question at 18:28:50 — after the detour had already started — and the rider never replied. An unrecorded oral 'no objection' is a claim, not consent (G11), and RD-5 requires the rider's own agreement before leaving the shortest route.
No LTA traffic incidents are present and the only speed bands on the corridor are band 3 (not the band 1–2 'severe congestion' range), so RD-4 provides no exemption for any segment.

Accepted only to the extent of the non-exempt detour mileage; the rest of the gap between the 7.884 km quoted route and the 10.87 km metered distance is map-matching residual and is not refundable under RD-2.
